/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/dil-thikana-mere-husain-ka-hai.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
before, roman_and_body = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
_, body = roman_and_body.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
stanzas = [
    ('Dil thikaana mere Husain ka hai', 'Ye khazaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Tum jise aasmaan samajhte ho', 'Shaamiyaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Koi puchhe ye daur kis ka hai', 'Tum bataana, mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Jis ke saaye mein kaainaat bani', 'Aisa naana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Ye jo Kaaba hai, tum na samjho ge', 'Ghar puraana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Aana farsh-e-aza pe beparda', 'Dil dukhaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Jis jagah Hur banaaye jaate haiṅ', 'Kaarkhaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Ho agar munkir-e-namaaz koi', 'Bhul jaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Dene waali hai zaat Allah ki', 'Par dilaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Maare ek zarb se hazaar adu', 'Kya nishaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Ug raha hai jo baad-e-karb o bala', 'Wo daana daana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Maatami jab koi nazar aaye', 'Maan jaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Kaash kehne lagiṅ ye log mujhe', 'Tu diwaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Ye jahaaṅ kya hai donoṅ aalam mein', 'Aana jaana mere Husain ka hai'),
    ('Mujh mein Rehan ye shuur jo hai', 'Shaairaana mere Husain ka hai'),
]
source_stanzas = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source_stanzas) == len(stanzas)
for n, (source, verses) in enumerate(zip(source_stanzas, stanzas), 1):
    number, *source_verses = source.splitlines()
    assert number == str(n).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
    assert len(source_verses) == len(verses)
    assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for verse in verses for c in verse)
roman = '\\n\\n'.join(f'  {n}\\n  {first}\\n  {second}' for n, (first, second) in enumerate(stanzas, 1))
p.write_bytes(before + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
updated = p.read_bytes()
assert updated.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == before
assert updated.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/dil-thikana-mere-husain-ka-hai.md"

Audited all 30 Roman verses against the Urdu across 15 stanzas. Corrected source mismatches such as `zarb`, `adu`, and `lagiṅ`, and normalized vowel spellings, nasal endings, capitalization, and punctuation.

The Urdu text and other metadata were preserved byte for byte. Human editorial sign-off remains pending.
